title: Design: Edit Credit Term window looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have the shop's own active term A, due 45 days after the invoice date, held by no customer, vendor or invoice.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Open the attached design picture ct-p3-04-edit-credit-term.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the term A row.
  2. Click "Edit".
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The row menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window titled "Edit Credit Term" opens, filled: Name term A (selected), "Due Net X days" chosen with 45 in the Days box, the Day box empty, the blue explanation line, and at the bottom right "Cancel" and "Save Changes" (blue) (as in ct-p3-04-edit-credit-term.png).
  • The Cancel style and the × colour: this attribute depends on question 12 (drawn pictures or build pictures, not answered yet): for now compare it with the picture named here.

Step 3:

  • At 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll.
  • The layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions), story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S2-R4: “"Edit" opens the "Edit Credit Term" window (Story 3: Create or edit a credit term) filled with the term's name, kind and days.”
  • S3-R1: “"New Credit Term" opens a window titled "New Credit Term"; Edit opens the same window titled "Edit Credit Term". The buttons are "Cancel" and "Create Credit Term" (New) or "Save Changes" (Edit).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
